caption: A top-down photo of a bowl of Japanese ramen with opaque reddish-brown miso broth. Wheat noodles are submerged in the broth, topped with sliced chashu pork. A soup spoon rests in the bowl. The bowl sits on a table, shot in warm natural light, appetizing food photography.

segments_info.text: The table surface behind the ramen bowl, softly out of focus.
A slice of chashu pork with a soft fat rim and browned white surface.
The opaque reddish-brown miso broth, with wheat noodles just under the surface.
A ceramic ramen bowl seen from above, its glazed rim catching the light.
A Chinese soup spoon resting in the bowl.
